name: Keeper Andrina

intro.text: I look after a light. A real one, a long way off. You will not see it from here, but I like to imagine it is watching.

win: A very good battle. The light is still on. I checked.
after: The Bell Rock was lit for the first time in 1811. A hundred and eighty years of keepers have stared at that horizon. Some of them stayed awake.
